2026-10-21 00:11:59.238650 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-10-21 00:11:59.238654 | controller |
2026-10-21 00:11:59.238658 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-10-21 00:11:59.238661 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-10-21 00:11:59.238664 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-10-21 00:11:59.238668 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-10-21 00:11:59.238671 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
